newsitem.title: USA: FDA accepts CollaGenex Periostat filing.
newsitem.headline: FDA accepts CollaGenex Periostat filing.

text.p: CollaGenex Pharmaceuticals Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration accepted its filing of a new drug application for its lead product, Periostat, to treat periodontitis.
The FDA informed CollaGenex that it will undertake a substantive review of Periostat, the company said.
Such a review is the next step in the process by which drugs are approved for prescription sales in the U.S.
It said Periostat is the first orally administered, systemically delivered drug to treat periodontitis, a leading cause of tooth loss.

CollaGenex said its application included clinically and statistically significant results from three Phase III clinical trials that demonstrated Periostat can reduce and reverse the progression of adult periodontitis.
